input_token_anomaly.observation: 3 of 12 model calls consumed ~12.5-13.2k input tokens; the other 9 consumed ~1.1-1.3k for structurally identical prompts
input_token_anomaly.correlation: input token magnitude tracks request-ID format exactly, not section content or evidence size
input_token_anomaly.inference: two distinct gateway/serving paths; the hex-ID path appears not to apply prompt caching
input_token_anomaly.cost_impact: roughly 11x input-token cost on affected calls; unpredictable which path serves a request
input_token_anomaly.status: unresolved - external to humanvoice, but it makes per-document cost non-deterministic and should be characterised before any cost guarantee is published
